question_text: Ìwé àgbà tí àwọn onímọ̀ àgbà lo fi ńkọ èdè Yorùbá ni a pè ní:
explanation: Kòkòrò Àwọn jẹ́ ìwé àgbà tí àwọn onímọ̀ èdè Yorùbá lo fún kọ́ni àti kọ́ ẹ̀kọ́ èdè Yorùbá.

question_text: Àwọn fáwẹ̀lì èdè Yorùbá melòò ni?
explanation: Èdè Yorùbá ní fáwẹ̀lì méje (a, e, ẹ, i, o, ọ, u) tí a ń pè ní 'ẹ̀éjèètá'.

question_text: Ìrò ohun méjèèje tí ó wà ní èdè Yorùbá ni a pè ní:
option_a: Ohun míi, ohun àárin, ohun ìsàlè
option_b: Ohun ìké, ohun ìbò, ohun ìsàlè
option_c: Ohun àárin, ohun ìbò, ohun míi
option_d: Ohun ìké, ohun àárin, ohun ìsàlè
explanation: Ìrò ohun méjèèje tí ó wà ní èdè Yorùbá ni ohun ìké (dó), ohun àárin (ré) àti ohun ìsàlè (míi).

question_text: Ọ̀kan lára àmi ohun tí a lo láti tóka ìrò ohun ní èdè Yorùbá ni:
explanation: Àmi dó (  ), àmi ré (  ) àti àmi míi (  ) ni a ń lo láti fi ṣàfihàn ìrò ohun méjèèje ní èdè Yorùbá.

question_text: Nínú àwọn fáwẹ̀lì èdè Yorùbá, àwọn fáwẹ̀lì tí a fi àmi ohun kò sì lòrí wọn ní:
explanation: Fáwẹ̀lì ẹ àti ọ ni a ń pe ni 'fáwẹ̀lì àmùgbá' nitori ti àmi ohun kò sì lòrí wọn ní èdè Yorùbá.

question_text: Ọ̀kan lára àwọn ìrò òfè èdè Yorùbá ni:
explanation: Gb jẹ́ ìrò òfè ní èdè Yorùbá, ó máa ń wọ́pọ̀ ní ìbẹ̀rẹ̀ àti àárin ọ̀rọ̀.

question_text: Nínú gẹ́ẹ̀sí èdè Yorùbá, 'Ìwé' ni a ṣàfihàn pé ó jẹ́:
explanation: Ìwé jẹ́ orúkọ àjẹ́mọ́ nitori ó jẹ́ n̄ǹkan gbégà, tí a lè fi ọwọ́ kan.

question_text: Èyí tí kò jẹ́ orúkọ àríkopọ̀ nínú àwọn orúkọ wọ̀nyí ni:
explanation: Aya jẹ́ orúkọ àjẹ́mọ́ ti o jẹ́ ìran ènìyàn, kò jẹ́ orúkọ àríkopọ̀. Aṣọ, ilé àti ọkọ̀ jẹ́ orúkọ àríkopọ̀.

question_text: Ọ̀kan lára àwọn orúkọ àfìkún nínú àwọn orúkọ wọ̀nyí ni:
explanation: Adùra jẹ́ orúkọ àfìkún nitori ó jẹ́ orúkọ ti a fi àwọn ọ̀rọ̀ mọ́ ra (A+dùrá).

question_text: Nínú ìlò èdè Yorùbá, 'Agò mí' jẹ́ àpẹẹrẹ tí:
explanation: 'Agò mí' jẹ́ àpẹẹrẹ tí ọ̀rọ̀-àrópọ̀-orúkọ (mi) nitoripe ó rópo orúkọ eni tí ó ni agò náà.

question_text: Ọ̀rọ̀-ìṣe nínú gbám̀bá àwọn ọ̀rọ̀ wọ̀nyí ni:
explanation: Jẹun jẹ́ ọ̀rọ̀-ìṣe nitori ó ṣàpẹẹrẹ ìṣe (jijẹ).

question_text: Èyí tí kò jẹ́ ọ̀rọ̀-àrópọ̀-orúkọ nínú àwọn wọ̀nyí ni:
explanation: Ilé jẹ́ ọ̀rọ̀-orúkọ, kò jẹ́ ọ̀rọ̀-àrópọ̀-orúkọ. Mi, o àti è jẹ́ ọ̀rọ̀-àrópọ̀-orúkọ.

question_text: Nínú àṣà Yorùbá, ìgbeyàwó àìgbà díẹ̀ ni a pè ní:
explanation: Ìgbeyàwó mọdá ni a ń pè ìgbeyàwó tí a ṣe láìgbà diẹ̀ fún òde lẹ́ni tí ó fẹ́.

question_text: Ọ̀kan lára àwọn ìwà àti ìṣe Yorùbá ti ó ń tójú ìbáṣepọ̀ láààrin àwọn ènìyàn ni:
explanation: Ìkiní jẹ́ ìwà àti ìṣe Yorùbá ti ó ń tójú ìbáṣepọ̀ láààrin àwọn ènìyàn, ó ń fi ọ̀wọ̀ àti ìfé hàn.

question_text: Ọ̀kan lára àwọn ààrẹ̀ ìlẹ̀ Yorùbá ni:
explanation: Ọba jẹ́ ààrẹ̀ ìlẹ̀ Yorùbá, ó jẹ́ olórìí ilẹ̀ kan ní ìjọba àti ìṣe àṣà Yorùbá.

question_text: Ilú Yorùbá tí a mò sí 'Ilú Olóhun-gbẹ̀rẹ̀' ni:
explanation: Òyó ni a ǹ pè ni 'Ilú Olóhun-gbẹ̀rẹ̀' nitori ó jẹ́ orísun àṣà Yorùbá àti ìlú tí Alààfin máa ń gbé.

question_text: Ààrẹ̀ tí ó ṣe ìdáàmúrá fún ìdá Òyó ni:
explanation: Òránmìyàn ni a mò sí olóri tí ó ṣe ìdáàmúrá fún ìdá Òyó gẹ́gẹ́ bi ìlú alágbára.

question_text: Ìwé àpọ̀nlé tí a ń lo fún kọ́ni bi a ṣe lé kọ èdè Yorùbá ni a pè ní:
explanation: Àlọ́ Àpọ̀nlé jẹ́ ìwé àpọ̀nlé tí a ń lo fún kọ́ni bi a ṣe lé kọ èdè Yorùbá.

question_text: Nínú àṣà Yorùbá, ìkúnlé ni a mò sí:
explanation: Ìkúnlé jẹ́ ọ̀nà ti a ń gbà dóbalẹ̀ fún àgbà ní àṣà Yorùbá, ti ó ń fi ọ̀wọ̀ àti ìbàwọ hàn.

question_text: Nínú àṣà Yorùbá, ìgbà tí a ń ṣe àléjò tí a ń pè ni 'àdá' ni:
explanation: Àdá jẹ́ ìgbà oorù ní àṣà Yorùbá, ìgbà tí a ń ṣe àléjò fún ìṣe àti ìjọ́sìn.

question_text: Ààrẹ̀ Yorùbá tí ó kọ́kọ́ gba ẹ̀kọ́ òyìnbó ní ilẹ̀ Yorùbá ni:
explanation: Bàsíọ̀rùn Gaa ni a mò sí ààrẹ̀ Yorùbá tí ó kọ́kọ́ gba ẹ̀kọ́ òyìnbó ní ilẹ̀ Yorùbá.

question_text: Nínú àṣà Yorùbá, ọ̀kan lára àwọn ìwà ti a ń pè ní 'ìwà ọmọlúàbí' ni:
explanation: Ìfáràbalé jẹ́ òkan lára àwọn ìwà ọmọlúàbí ní àṣà Yorùbá, ó ń fi ọ̀wọ̀ àti ìtẹ̀lọ́rún hàn.

question_text: Ọ̀kan lára àwọn ìtàn ìdilé Yorùbá ti a ń pè ní 'ìtàn àkọ́lẹ̀' ni:
explanation: Ìtàn Òránmìyàn jẹ́ ìtàn ìdilé Yorùbá ti ó ṣe àkọ́lẹ̀ bi a ṣe dá Òyó sì.

question_text: Nínú èdè Yorùbá, 'E káárò' jẹ́ ìkíní ti a ń lo ní:
explanation: 'E káárò' jẹ́ ìkíní ti a ń lo ní òwúrò fún kíní ènìyàn.

question_text: Ọ̀kan lára àwọn òǹkà ti a ń lo fún ṣíṣe àròkò onímọ̀ ni:
explanation: Àròkò onímọ̀ jẹ́ òkan lára àwọn òǹkà ti a ń lo fún ṣíṣe àròkò ní èdè Yorùbá.

question_text: Nínú àṣà Yorùbá, ọ̀kan lára àwọn ìwà ti ó ń fi ọ̀wọ̀ àgbà hàn ni:
explanation: Ìdóbalẹ̀ jẹ́ ìwà ti ó ń fi ọ̀wọ̀ àgbà hàn ní àṣà Yorùbá, ti a ń lo fún àwọn aláàgbà.

question_text: Ọ̀kan lára àwọn àwọn ìtàn ìdilé Yorùbá ti ó ń sọ̀rọ̀̀ ńpa ìṣẹ̀dá ayé ni:
explanation: Ìtàn Òrúmílá jẹ́ ìtàn ìdilé Yorùbá ti ó ń sọ̀rọ̀̀ ńpa ìṣẹ̀dá ayé àti bi a ṣe ṣe àdámọ̀.

question_text: Nínú àṣà Yorùbá, ìkúnlé jẹ́ ìdóbalẹ̀ fún:
explanation: Ìkúnlé jẹ́ ìdóbalẹ̀ ti a ń fún àwọn àgbà ní àṣà Yorùbá, ti ó ń fi ọ̀wọ̀ àti ìbàwọ hàn.

question_text: Ọ̀kan lára àwọn ìwé àpọ̀nlé Yorùbá ti a ń lo fún kọ́ni èdè Yorùbá ni:
explanation: Gbogbo ìwé wọ̀nyí ni a ń lo fún kọ́ni èdè Yorùbá ní òǹkà oríṣiríṣi.

question_text: Nínú àṣà Yorùbá, ọ̀kan lára àwọn ìwà ti ó ń fi ìwọ̀nba hàn ni:
explanation: Ìwọ̀ntúnwọ̀nsin jẹ́ ìwà ti ó ń fi ìwọ̀nba hàn ní àṣà Yorùbá, ti ó ń fi àyò àti ìdùpẹ́ hàn.

question_text: Ọ̀kan lára àwọn ìtàn ìdilé Yorùbá ti ó ń sọ̀rọ̀̀ ńpa ìṣe Alààfin Àbìpá ni:
explanation: Ìtàn Alààfin Àbìpá jẹ́ ìtàn ìdilé Yorùbá ti ó ń sọ̀rọ̀̀ ńpa ìṣe Alààfin Àbìpá, olóri ti ó ṣe ìdáàmúrá fún Òyó.

question_text: Nínú èdè Yorùbá, àwọn fáwẹ̀lì àmùgbá ni a pè ní:
explanation: Fáwẹ̀lì àmùgbá ni a ń pè ní ẹ àti ọ nitori ti a kò lè ṣàpẹẹrẹ wọn láìlò àmi ohun.

question_text: Ìrò ófè kan nínú àwọn ìrò yìí ti a kò ní nínú èdè Yorùbá ni:
explanation: Ìrò 'V' kò sí nínú àwọn ìrò ófè èdè Yorùbá. Ìrò yìí jẹ́ ìrò òfè ti a kò lè pe ní èdè Yorùbá.

question_text: Nínú àwọn fáwẹ̀lì èdè Yorùbá, èwo ni a ń pè ni 'fáwẹ̀lì àmùgbá'?
explanation: Fáwẹ̀lì ẹ àti Ọ ni a ń pè ni 'fáwẹ̀lì àmùgbá' nitori pé a kò lè ṣàpẹẹrẹ wọn láìlò àmi ohun.

question_text: Ìrò ohun méjèèje ti a ń lo ní èdè Yorùbá ni a pè ní:
explanation: Ìrò ohun méjèèje ní èdè Yorùbá ni 'Dó' (ohun ìké), 'Ré' (ohun àárin), àti 'Míi' (ohun ìsàlè).

question_text: Nínú gẹ́ẹ̀sí èdè Yorùbá, ìlò àmi ohun lè yí ìtùmò ọ̀rọ̀ padà. Àpẹẹrẹ, 'ọ̀kọ̀' àti 'ọkọ̀' jẹ́ àpẹẹrẹ tí:
explanation: 'Ọ̀kọ̀' (car) àti 'ọkọ̀' (hoe) jẹ́ àpẹẹrẹ ìrò ohun ti ó yàtọ̀. Ọ̀kọ̀ ni ohun ìké (dó), ọkọ̀ ni ohun ìsàlè (míi).

question_text: Ọ̀kan lára àwọn àmi ohun ti a ń lo ní èdè Yorùbá ni a pè ní:
explanation: Àmi dó (  ) jẹ́ òkan lára àwọn àmi ohun méjèèje ti a ń lo ní èdè Yorùbá.

question_text: Nínú àwọn orúkọ wọ̀nyí, èwo ni ó jẹ́ orúkọ àjẹ́mọ́?
explanation: Ìyà jẹ́ orúkọ àjẹ́mọ́ nitori ó jẹ́ ìran ènìyàn. Ìwà, ìfé, àti ìró jẹ́ orúkọ àríkopọ̀.

question_text: Àpẹẹrẹ tí ọ̀rọ̀-àrópọ̀-orúkọ ti ó jẹ́ onípẹẹjọ kan ni:
explanation: Òun jẹ́ ọ̀rọ̀-àrópọ̀-orúkọ onípẹẹjọ kan (third person singular). Awa àti ẹ̀yin jẹ́ ọ̀pọ̀ (plural), àǹgbà jẹ́ ọ̀rọ̀-orúkọ.

question_text: Nínú àwọn ọ̀rọ̀ wọ̀nyí, èwo ni ó jẹ́ ọ̀rọ̀-ìṣe?
explanation: Sùn jẹ́ ọ̀rọ̀-ìṣe (verb) nitori ó ṣàpẹẹrẹ ìṣe. Ìyá, ìlú, àti ọba jẹ́ ọ̀rọ̀-orúkọ.

question_text: Ọ̀kan lára àwọn ìlò èdè ti a ń pè ní 'àrótẹ̀lẹ̀' ni:
explanation: Àwè jẹ́ ìlò èdè ti a ń pè ní 'àrótẹ̀lẹ̀', ti a ń lo láti fi ọ̀gbọ́n hàn nínú ìjíròrò.

question_text: Nínú àṣà Yorùbá, ìgbà tí a ń ṣe ìdánòjún ìwọ̀nba ni a pè ní:
explanation: Ìwọ̀ntúnwọ̀nsin ni a ń pè ìgbà tí a ń ṣe ìdánòjún ìwọ̀nba ní àṣà Yorùbá.

question_text: Ọ̀kan lára àwọn ààrẹ̀ ìlẹ̀ Yorùbá ti a mò sí 'Olóri Ọba' ni:
explanation: Alààfin ni a mò sí 'Olóri Ọba' ní ilẹ̀ Yorùbá, ó jẹ́ olóri ti ó ga jùlọ ní ìjọba àti àṣà.

question_text: Ilú Yorùbá ti a mò sí 'Ilú Olú-Ọba' ni:
explanation: Ifẹ ni a mò sí 'Ilú Olú-Ọba' nitori ó jẹ́ orísun ìjọba àti àṣà Yorùbá.

question_text: Nínú àṣà Yorùbá, ọ̀kan lára àwọn òǹkà ti a ń gbà fún kíní ènìyàn ni:
explanation: Ìkiní jẹ́ òǹkà ti a ń gbà fún kíní ènìyàn ní àṣà Yorùbá, ti ó ń fi ọ̀wọ̀ àti ìfé hàn.

question_text: Nínú àwọn ọ̀rọ̀ wọ̀nyí, èwo ni ó jẹ́ ọ̀rọ̀-àrópọ̀-orúkọ onípẹẹjọ méjì?
explanation: Awa jẹ́ ọ̀rọ̀-àrópọ̀-orúkọ onípẹẹjọ méjì (first person plural). Ẹ̀yin jẹ́ onípẹẹjọ keji plural, òun jẹ́ singular.

question_text: Ọ̀kan lára àwọn ìlò èdè ti a ń pè ní 'àfìwè' ni:
explanation: 'Bí... tí' jẹ́ ìlò èdè àfìwè ti a ń lo láti fi hàn ìránrán láààrin n̄ǹkan méjì.

question_text: Ọ̀kan lára àwọn ìtàn ìdilé Yorùbá ti ó ń sọ̀rọ̀̀ ńpa ìṣe Òránmìyàn ni:
explanation: Ìtàn Òránmìyàn jẹ́ ìtàn ìdilé Yorùbá ti ó ń sọ̀rọ̀̀ ńpa ìṣe Òránmìyàn, olóri ti ó ṣe ìdáàmúrá fún ìdá Òyó.

question_text: Nínú àṣà Yorùbá, ìgbà tí a ń ṣe ìṣẹ̀ṣe ìyáwó ni a pè ní:
explanation: Ìgbeyàwó ni a ń pè ìgbà tí a ń ṣe ìṣẹ̀ṣe ìyáwó ní àṣà Yorùbá.
